notes: IEEE 1516.1-2025 public-API evoked-ordering scenario: a published requester queues Attribute Ownership Acquisition If Available for an owner-held attribute, the owner begins negotiated divestiture, and the owner receives a confirmation request identifying the requester. Ownership remains with the owner until Confirm Divestiture returns; then it transfers immediately before the requester's acquisition callback is evoked, and that callback carries the confirmation tag. Pinned native page-152-l101-32 maps to §7.1.2.2 positive eligibility; page-151-l132-43 maps only the negotiated-divestiture transfer branch of §7.1.2.1. Immediate callback mode resolves the If Available request at a different boundary and is explicitly skipped, not treated as passing or conformance. The adapter supplies provider, endpoint, FOM and names, HLA_EVOKED, and logical-time implementation. Installed-package C++ primary/contract passed 2/2 evoked; Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR without provider-runtime evidence.
